name: Gorrm the Unroped
lore: Gorrm was ko-Ghast until the Moot priced a Kharrow herdsman's death at a hundred head and Ghast would not pay it for him. He did not kill the herdsman; he says so, and the Moot says so now, and it was too late by then. He keeps the Unroped by the one law he still holds with, that a price paid is a price paid, and he has begun paying prices in advance.

phases.name: paid in advance
phases.say: He wraps his broken chain round his fist and calls the price. The ones still standing come.

name: The Keener of Orrdun
lore: Hethra ko-Skarl went up to Orrdun behind the last bier ninety years ago to sing its name in, and when the Breath did not come she sang the name before it, and the one before that, back to the first. She has not stopped. Her voice has gone to a shriek and her hands to claws in the joints of the rock, and she still knows every name in Orrdun in the order it came. If you stand still long enough she will sing yours, and put it in its place.

phases.name: the name before
phases.say: She stops at a name and screams it, and the niches answer. What was lying in them is getting up.

name: The Kneeling Brakh
lore: What the Breath left of a giant who was drinking when it came: the bones kept, the rest taken, and three thousand years of the lake's lime grown over the bones until they could stand again. It still kneels. It still has its hands in the water. Whatever it lifts out of the lake it lets the water carry down to the Skarl, as if it wanted somebody to know it was there.

phases.name: the drinker
phases.say: It lifts its hands out of the lake. The water runs out of them for a long time.

phases.name: stands
phases.say: For the first time in three thousand years it gets off its knees.
